info.title: Clutch API
info.description: The /api/v1 surface of Clutch. Success is `{ data, count? }`, failure `{ error, message, details? }` with `error` from ErrorCode. Generated from the handlers' schemas (apps/web/app/api/v1/_contract); do not edit by hand. Clients must ignore fields they do not know: adding a field is not a breaking change.

get.summary: Service discovery
get.description: Confirms connectivity, the deployed API version and the auth scheme. The authoritative list of operations is this document (docs/api/openapi.json).

post.summary: Sign in with an Apple or Google ID token
post.description: Creates the account on a first sign-in. A token the provider cannot verify is invalid_credentials, and so is one for a banned account, with the same message: this API's answer never says which addresses are banned; the identity provider, called directly with the publishable key, still does. The app's Apple bundle id and Google client ids must be authorized on the deployment's identity provider. 429 rate_limit_exceeded: thirty a minute per client, from the same budget as password sign-in.

post.summary: Email a sign-in code
post.description: Follow with POST /auth/otp/verify. Without `create_user`, every address is answered the same 202 at once, and the email is sent after the answer: an address with no account gets none, and neither the answer nor its timing says which addresses have accounts. (The identity provider itself, called directly, still can; this is about the API's answer.) With `create_user`, an address with no account gets one (and `full_name` on its profile); its first email is the address confirmation, which carries the code too. Also the first step of a password reset: verify the code, then POST /auth/password. 400 invalid_field: a malformed address, with `create_user` (without it, a malformed address is one with no account). 429 rate_limit_exceeded: five requests a minute per address, twenty per client; spent the same for every address.

post.summary: Exchange an emailed code for a session
post.description: A code is single use, and expires after the lifetime the deployment sets. A wrong, expired or used one is invalid_credentials, and so is any code for a banned account, with the same message: this API's answer never says which addresses are banned; the identity provider, called directly with the publishable key, still does. 400 invalid_field: a malformed address. 429 rate_limit_exceeded: five tries a minute per address from one client, thirty per client, and ten an hour and thirty a day per address from all clients together. Anyone can spend those last two by sending wrong codes for an address: code sign-in and the native password reset then stop for it until they refill. An account with a password, Apple or Google still signs in that way; one that only ever used codes cannot sign in natively until then. The web sign-in link is not affected. The per-address budget is what bounds guessing a 6-digit code through this API from many clients at once. It bounds only this API: the identity provider, called directly with the publishable key, limits code checks per client address alone.

post.summary: Set the signed-in account's password
post.description: Needs a person's access token: an API key is answered 401. An expired access token, or one whose session has ended (signed out, or its account deleted or banned), is `401 session_expired`. Needs a session that signed in moments ago, by the same freshness rule as deleting the account (a session made from an emailed code just now passes): otherwise `403 step_up_required`, whose `details` say how to sign in again (`methods`); sign in, then retry with the new access token. When that check cannot be made, or the identity provider cannot be reached, `502 upstream_error`: retry, do not sign in again. So is a deployment whose provider asks for the current password to change one (DEPLOYMENT.md asks for that setting off). A second factor is checked separately, by the provider: an account that has one, on a session that has not passed it, is `401 mfa_required`. Every other session of the account is signed out; this one stays. A password the account already has is invalid_field.

post.summary: Send a password-reset email
post.description: 202 whether or not the address has an account, at once: the email is sent after the answer, so its timing says nothing either. `redirect_to` must be on the deployment's allow-list or the provider ignores it. 429 rate_limit_exceeded: five requests a minute per address, twenty per client, from the same budget as the web reset form; spent the same for every address, so it says nothing about which have accounts.

post.summary: Trade a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Refresh tokens rotate: store the new pair.

post.summary: End the session
post.description: `local` (the default) ends this session and its refresh token; `global` ends every session of the account. A session already ended is answered 200 too, as is a token whose account has been deleted: nothing is left to end. A banned account's is `401 session_expired`: the provider refuses it before revoking anything, so its sessions are not said to have ended. An expired access token is `401 session_expired`, as on every other route: refresh, then sign out, or forget the session on the device. `502 upstream_error` means the provider could not answer: retry. Needs a person's access token: an API key is answered 401. Unregister push (DELETE /me/devices) first: it needs the session.

post.summary: Create an account
post.description: A new account belongs to no club: follow with POST /clubs/{club}/join. With email confirmation on (production), the answer is 202 and no session: the person confirms the address, then signs in. 429 rate_limit_exceeded: five a minute per address, twenty per client, from the same budget as the web sign-up form.

201.description: Created and signed in (email confirmation off).

202.description: Created; the email address must be confirmed first.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for a session
post.description: A wrong email or password is invalid_credentials, and so is a banned account, with the same message: this API's answer never says which addresses are banned; the identity provider, called directly with the publishable key, still does. 429 rate_limit_exceeded: five tries a minute per address from one client, thirty per client, from the same budget as the web sign-in form.

get.summary: The caller's bookings at one club
get.description: Bookings the caller made (not ones they were invited to: see GET /me/bookings?include=invitations). Newest first, or oldest first from `from`.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club whose bookings to list.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings on or after this day. With it the list runs oldest first; without it, newest first.

post.summary: Hold a court slot
post.description: Creates a `pending` booking that holds the court for 15 minutes. The price is computed server-side. Pay for it and confirm it (POST /bookings/{id}/confirm), or confirm it directly to pay at the club. Two clients racing for one slot cannot both win: the loser gets `409 slot_already_booked`.

get.summary: One booking, with its court, players and dues
get.description: Any booking the caller may see: their own, one they play on, one in a club they belong to, or an open-play session. `404` also means not visible; the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, cancels it (another member of its club gets `403 not_authorized`, anyone else `404`). The booker's own cancel applies the club's cancellation window: before it closes everything they paid goes back; after it, a club that takes a late cancel keeps their money and one that does not refuses (`409 cancellation_window_passed`). The booker sends the `refund` GET /bookings/{id}/cancellation answered as `accepted_refund` (omitted means `full`), and a cancel that would do otherwise with their money is refused (`409 cancel_terms_changed`), never done on terms they did not see. A booker cannot cancel a booking that has started, been checked in or marked a no-show, or a lesson's court row. Staff cancel any live booking and every payment goes back. The slot is released and anyone on the waiting list is told. The terms come in the JSON body or the query string (`?accepted_refund=none`, for a client that sends no body with a DELETE); a field given in both must say the same (`400 invalid_field` otherwise).

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Up to 500 characters. Accepted, not recorded yet.

parameters.name: accepted_refund
parameters.description: The booker's own cancel: the `refund` GET /bookings/{id}/cancellation answered, `full` or `none`. Omitted means `full`. Ignored for staff.

post.summary: Cancel a booking
post.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, cancels it (another member of its club gets `403 not_authorized`, anyone else `404`). The booker's own cancel applies the club's cancellation window: before it closes everything they paid goes back; after it, a club that takes a late cancel keeps their money and one that does not refuses (`409 cancellation_window_passed`). The booker sends the `refund` GET /bookings/{id}/cancellation answered as `accepted_refund` (omitted means `full`), and a cancel that would do otherwise with their money is refused (`409 cancel_terms_changed`), never done on terms they did not see. A booker cannot cancel a booking that has started, been checked in or marked a no-show, or a lesson's court row. Staff cancel any live booking and every payment goes back. The slot is released and anyone on the waiting list is told.

get.summary: What cancelling your own booking now would do
get.description: To show before the booker confirms a cancel, and to send back as its `accepted_refund`. Advisory: POST /bookings/{id}/cancel decides again when it runs. A booking the booker may not cancel at all answers that refusal; someone else's booking answers `404`.

post.summary: Confirm the caller's pending booking
post.description: Moves the caller's `pending` booking to `confirmed` and clears its hold. With `payment_intent_id`, the intent must have succeeded for exactly this booking and this caller (`402 payment_not_verified` otherwise, and the booking stays pending); it is recorded as the payment only if it covers the price at this moment. Without it the booking is to be paid at the club. Confirming again after the payment already confirmed it returns the booking.

post.summary: Invite a group's roster onto the caller's booking
post.description: The group's current active club members are invited in one transaction (a snapshot), bounded by the seats left. The booking must be the caller's, confirmed and not ended, and the caller in the group. Existing shares never change; new invitees split only what nobody has paid or promised, or owe nothing when the booker already paid.

post.summary: Invite club members onto a booking
post.description: The booker, or club staff who may manage bookings, invites members (anyone the booking cannot take is skipped, not refused), bounded by the booking's seats. A player who already accepted or paid is never changed; a declined one is invited again. Shares come out of what the booking still owes and nobody has promised; without `shares` it is split evenly.

200.description: Who this call invited, and who it did not.

delete.summary: Take a player off a booking, or leave it
delete.description: Your own id: you leave, an unanswered invitation included. Before the club's cancellation window what you paid goes back to you and the booker owes it again; inside it, it stays with the booking, which then owes less. At a club that takes no payment at the venue the booker covers a refunded share: their saved card for the club is charged it plus tax off-session, once per leave, or they are told to pay it in the app. Someone else: only the booker (before the booking starts) or a club manager (before it ends) may; whatever that player paid is refunded to them and the booker owes it again. A booker cannot send away a player who paid once the window keeps money (`cancellation_window_passed`). At a club that takes no payment at the venue a player who paid is removed by paying their share (`402 removal_payment_required`: POST /bookings/{id}/players/{userId}/removal/payment-intent, then .../confirm); a manager is told the booker covers the share or the booking is cancelled (`removal_needs_booker_cover`). Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry with the same key is the same removal, answered as the first was, and refunds and tells nobody twice (a key longer than 255 characters is cut to its first 255).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The player: your own id to leave.

200.description: The player is off the booking.

post.summary: Remove the player with the payment for their share
post.description: The player is taken off and their payment toward the booking is refunded; yours takes its place. The Stripe webhook does the same if it hears of the payment first; calling this after it is safe. `payment_not_verified`: not your payment for removing this player from this booking (nothing is recorded). `removal_not_applied` with `details.reason` (booking_changed, cancellation_window_passed, order_expired, booking_started, ...): nobody was removed and your payment is being refunded.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The player: your own id to leave.

200.description: The player is off the booking.

post.summary: Pay to take a player who paid their share off your booking
post.description: The booker only, at a club that takes no payment at the venue (DELETE /bookings/{id}/players/{userId} answered `removal_payment_required`). Opens a removal order (it holds until `expires_at`; the same removal asked again returns it while it still matches the booking; any other new order on the booking replaces it) and a PaymentIntent for what the player's payment holds toward the booking, plus tax, on the club's connected account. Then POST /bookings/{id}/players/{userId}/removal/confirm with the intent. `nothing_to_pay`: remove them with DELETE.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The player: your own id to leave.

post.summary: Let go of your own unpaid hold
post.description: For an abandoned checkout. It cancels the booking only while it is still your pending hold, checked under the booking's lock; a booking the server has confirmed meanwhile (the confirm's answer was lost, or the payment landed through the webhook) is left alone and answers `409 booking_not_pending` with `details.status`. Use POST /bookings/{id}/cancel to cancel a confirmed booking on purpose. The server asks the payment provider about every checkout opened for the hold, plus `payment_intent_id` if it is yours: an open one is cancelled first; a payment that went through confirms the hold instead (`booking_not_pending` with status `confirmed`; if it cannot confirm yet the hold is kept and the confirm's refusal is answered: `waiver_required`, `payment_required`, `max_bookings_reached`, `payment_processing`, `booking_changed` or `upstream_error`); one still clearing keeps it (`payment_processing`); one that cannot be asked about keeps it (`upstream_error`). A court whose open checkout also pays for other courts still held is refused (`409 hold_in_bundle`) and nothing is cancelled.

post.summary: Move the caller's booking to another slot
post.description: Only the booker moves their own booking; anyone else's answers `404`. The cancel rule applies, and only a plain court booking moves (not a lesson's court, not one date of a standing reservation). A booking with anything collected or committed toward it, or priced by staff, keeps its price and moves only to a slot whose court time costs no more (`409 reschedule_costs_more`); anything else is repriced at the new slot. A paid booking moving to a dearer slot is paid for first (`402 reschedule_payment_required`): POST /bookings/{id}/reschedule/quote, then .../reschedule/payment-intent and .../reschedule/confirm.

post.summary: Make a paid move with its payment
post.description: The Stripe webhook makes the same move if it hears of the payment first; calling this after it is safe. `move_not_applied` with `details.reason` (slot_already_booked, booking_changed, cancellation_window_passed, cannot_book_past, order_expired, max_bookings_reached, ...): the move was not made and the payment is being refunded. A refusal of the payment write keeps its own code; only a write that failed for the moment is `502 upstream_error` (retry).

post.summary: Pay for moving a paid booking to a dearer slot
post.description: Opens a move order (it holds until `expires_at`; the same move asked again returns it while it still matches the booking; any other replaces it) and a PaymentIntent for the difference plus tax on the club's connected account. Then POST /bookings/{id}/reschedule/confirm with the intent. The slot is not held: if it is taken, or the booking changes, before the payment lands, the move is not made and the payment is refunded. `nothing_to_pay`: move it with POST /bookings/{id}/reschedule.

post.summary: What moving your booking to a slot would cost
post.description: Refuses exactly what the move refuses. Writes nothing.

post.summary: Accept or decline your invitation onto a booking
post.description: Only a pending invitation can be answered (`409 invite_not_pending`). Accepting takes a seat on a confirmed booking that has not ended, as an active member of its club in good standing. The booker is told.

post.summary: Settle your share with its payment
post.description: The server asks the payment provider (the simulated one in test mode) whether it is your share payment for this booking and whether it is money, then records it through the one locked write the Stripe webhook also uses, so calling this before or after the webhook records it once. `payment_returned` with `details.reason`: the booking could not take it (for example you left, or someone paid your part) and it is being refunded.

200.description: What you still owe and hold.

post.summary: Pay your share of a booking someone else booked
post.description: The amount is what you owe (your share less what you paid), plus tax as every booking checkout computes it, on the club's connected account. Shares open once the booker has confirmed (`409 shares_not_open`). Then POST /bookings/{id}/shares/confirm with the intent. In simulated mode pay it with POST /bookings/{id}/payment-intent/pay.

post.summary: What booking a slot would cost, without booking it
post.description: The same plan POST /bookings runs (every rule it refuses with, member pricing including for a visitor the booking would join, a discount code, the clubs that sell only priced time) plus tax as the checkout computes it. Writes nothing.

post.summary: Cancel the caller's registration for a class session
post.description: Within the club's cancellation window only. A confirmed registration paid with a pass gives the pass back. Cancelling one that is already cancelled succeeds.

post.summary: Register for a class session
post.description: Needs a confirmed enrollment in the session's program. A session that is not free spends one of the enrollment's session passes (`no_session_passes` when none is left). A session that filled up first answers with status `waitlisted`, not an error.

post.summary: Join a full class session's waitlist
post.description: Only for a full session: one with places left answers `session_not_full`, so register instead.

201.description: The waitlisted registration and its position.

get.summary: The club directory
get.description: Active clubs by name, the same for every caller.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the club's name, any case.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only clubs with a court of this CourtType. Any other value matches no club (an empty page, not an error).

post.summary: Create a club with its courts, hours, rules and pricing
post.description: One database transaction: a failure leaves nothing behind. The caller needs `clubs:create` (an API key) or a platform role that creates clubs (an access token), and becomes the owner unless `owner_user_id` says otherwise. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry then replays the first answer instead of failing with `slug_already_exists`.

201.description: The new club, as `GET /clubs/{club}` answers it.

get.summary: One club, with its courts, hours, pricing and booking rules

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

get.summary: The slot grid for one day, priced for the caller
get.description: Every active court with every slot of the day and its status, accounting for bookings, recurring bookings, academy sessions, closures and opening hours. Prices are for the caller: send the member's token to get member prices; without one, public prices. A token the auth server rejects is refused rather than priced as a visitor. There is no realtime feed: re-fetch every 15 to 30 seconds for a live grid.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day, in the club's timezone.

200.description: One entry per court, in display order.

get.summary: How each court type of the club books, and whether the caller may
get.description: Slot length, durations, how far ahead, the daily cap, the week of opening hours and the plans a court type is kept for, composed by the same rules a booking is checked against. With a token, each court type also says whether the caller may book it and if not why.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

get.summary: The caller's class sessions on a day
get.description: Scheduled sessions on `date` of the programs the caller is confirmed in, grouped by program, in start order. Empty for a caller who is not an evaluated student of the club, or who is in no program with a session that day.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

200.description: The programs with sessions that day; `count` is how many.

get.summary: The club's bookable courts, in display order

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

post.summary: Join a club as a player
post.description: Idempotent. `joined` is true when this call created the membership; otherwise the caller already had one and `status` says what it is. Joining again does not lift a suspension. Read GET /me afterwards for the full membership: never infer membership from this call alone.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

200.description: Where the caller now stands at the club.

get.summary: The club's membership plans and the caller's own

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

get.summary: Find fellow members to invite onto a booking
get.description: For an active member of the club: other active members whose username, or a word of whose full name, starts with `q`, minus anyone either of them blocked. A search, never a roster: `q` shorter than 2 characters is `invalid_field`. The first 200 results are all there is.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters (after trimming), at most 100.

get.summary: Programs the caller may enroll in
get.description: Published and running programs, in term order, filtered to what the caller may see: programs are for evaluated students (staff and coaches see all), a levelled program only for members on that level, a private one only through an enrollment. Empty for a member who has not been evaluated yet.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: The club's id or its slug.

post.summary: Record a payment for a program place once Stripe confirms it
post.description: The payment is verified with Stripe first. The webhook records it too: whichever comes first records it, and the other changes nothing and answers the same outcome. Someone who may not pay for the place is answered as if it did not exist (`enrollment_not_found`).

post.summary: Start, or resume, paying for a program place
post.description: For a place that is `payable`: the caller's own, or one of a child they act for as guardian. A payment already in progress for the place is resumed rather than started twice. Someone who may not pay for the place is answered as if it did not exist (`enrollment_not_found`). A place the club has yet to confirm, or one already settled, is `booking_not_pending`; a free one `nothing_to_pay`; one whose program filled up while it waited `session_full`.

post.summary: Accept or decline an invitation
post.description: Only the invitee may answer. `invitation_not_found` also means the invitation is someone else's.

get.summary: One group with its roster
get.description: Members only. A non-member gets `403 not_authorized` whether or not the group exists.

patch.description: Owner only. Any of the fields; the others are left as they are.

delete.description: Owner only. Removes the roster, invitations and links; the group's chat lives on as a plain group conversation.

get.summary: Bookings organised with the group
get.description: Members only. `upcoming` is a live booking that has not ended on the club's clock, soonest first; `past` is everything else (cancelled and completed included), latest first. At most 50.

post.summary: Get or create the group's chat
post.description: Members only. Answers 201 whether the chat was created now or already existed. Its participants follow the roster: a member who joins later is added, one who leaves or is removed loses the chat.

post.summary: Upload the group's cover image
post.description: Owner only. Replaces the previous cover.

201.description: The cover's public URL (also the group's new `cover_image_url`).

post.summary: Invite people to a group
post.description: Any member may invite. People who are not active members of the club, are already on the roster or already invited are skipped.

post.summary: Mint a join link
post.description: Any member may mint one. The raw `token` is in this response and nowhere else: only its hash is stored, so it cannot be read back later (a retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays this response). A link dies with its creator's membership.

201.description: The link, with its token shown this once.

post.summary: Leave a group
post.description: An owner with other members must transfer ownership first. The last member leaving deletes the group.

get.summary: A group's roster
get.description: Members only. The same roster `GET /groups/{id}` carries.

patch.description: The only role change there is: ownership moves to that member and the caller becomes a member. The caller must be the current owner.

delete.description: Owner only. Removal is durable: the invite links the member created and the pending invitations they sent or held are revoked with them, and they lose the group chat.

post.summary: See the group behind an invite link
post.description: Does not use up the link. The group's `my_role` is null unless the caller is already a member. `410 invite_link_invalid` for any link that is not live.

200.description: The group, and whether the caller is on its roster.

post.summary: Join a group with an invite link
post.description: Uses one of the link's joins. `410 invite_link_invalid` when the link is unknown, expired, revoked, used up, or its creator has left.

get.summary: The caller's profile and every club membership
get.description: The first call after sign-in: the token carries no roles and no club. `memberships` lists every membership whatever its standing (`status`), so an empty list means the account has joined no club, and a suspended membership is visible as one. If either part cannot be read the request fails; it never answers with a partial list.

delete.summary: Delete the caller's own account, for good
delete.description: The same path as the profile page's button. Only a person's own access token can do this: an API key acts as a service account, never as the person, and is answered 401. `403 step_up_required`: sign in again by one of `details.methods` and retry with the new access token. `409 account_deletion_blocked`: `details` names the clubs and children. Five attempts an hour per account. `500 account_deletion_failed`: nothing was deleted. On success every token of the account is dead.

get.summary: What deleting the caller's account would meet
get.description: Before the person is asked to sign in again for it. `step_up.satisfied` false means DELETE /me/account answers `403 step_up_required` until they sign in again by one of `step_up.methods`. Nothing here is a promise: the deletion asks all of it again, the database under a lock.

200.description: The blockers and the step-up state.

post.summary: Upload the caller's avatar
post.description: multipart/form-data with one `file` field: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at most 5 MB. The profile's avatar_url is set to the returned URL.

get.summary: Every booking the caller is on, or their pending invitations
get.description: Without `include`: bookings the caller made (`role: booker`) and ones they hold an accepted place on (`role: player`), each `kind: booking`. Newest first; with `from`, from that date on, earliest first. With `include=invitations`: the invitations they have not answered yet, each `kind: invitation`, every one of them (`count` is how many). Branch on `kind`.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club whose bookings to list.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings on or after this day. With it the list runs oldest first; without it, newest first.

200.description: A page of bookings, or every pending invitation.

get.summary: A short-lived signed token for the caller's member QR
get.description: Show `token` as the QR, as it is. Ask for the next one `ttl_seconds` minus a margin after this response ARRIVED, not by comparing `expires_at` with the device clock, which may be off by minutes: the club's scanner refuses an expired token by the server's clock. Only an active member of the club gets one.

get.summary: The caller's credit balance at a club
get.description: A booking paid with credits costs one credit whatever its price, so do not present credits as money. The transaction log is GET /me/credits/history (`include=history` here is refused with invalid_field).

200.description: The balance; zero when the club never granted any.

get.summary: The caller's credit transactions at a club, newest first

post.summary: Deliver the caller's push notices to this install
post.description: While the caller's current session lives. The account is the session, never the body. Registering again is harmless: the app may do it on every launch, and must after each sign-in.

delete.summary: Stop pushing the caller's notices to this install
delete.description: The token travels in the body, not the URL, so it is not written to request logs. Call it before ending the session, then sign out with scope "local" (the default signs the account out everywhere). Only the caller's own registration is removed.

200.description: `removed` is false when the caller had no registration for that token.

post.summary: Complete a registration with the pushed code
post.description: For a registration that answered `verification_required`. A code works once, for ten minutes and five tries; a wrong, used or expired one is `409 device_verification_invalid`.

get.summary: The caller's program enrollments at a club
get.description: Newest first. A cancelled enrollment stays listed for two minutes after it was cancelled, then drops off.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The club the list is about.

get.summary: The caller's pending group invitations
get.description: Newest first. Invitations from a club where the caller is not an active member are left out: they cannot be accepted.

get.summary: The caller's groups
get.description: Newest first, across every club where the caller is an active member. `club_id` keeps the list to one club.

post.summary: Create a group
post.description: The caller becomes its owner. The listed people are invited in the same transaction; anyone who is not an active member of the club is skipped.

get.summary: The home screen in one call
get.description: The caller's profile, their next pending or confirmed bookings at the club (up to 10, from today, oldest first) and the club's latest announcements (up to 5). Each part must load or the request fails. For the authoritative booking list use GET /me/bookings.

get.summary: Your active weekly series
get.description: At one club, or at every club without `club_id`. An occurrence is charged `agreed_price_cents` (from `pending_price_from` on, `pending_price_cents`), or `current_price_cents` when that is lower, plus tax when the saved card is charged.

post.summary: Renew your weekly series at the club's current price
post.description: Renewing agrees the series at the club's current price for its slot, from the next occurrence on, and replaces any rise the club announced. If the price or its currency moved since you were shown it, or the series' terms changed meanwhile, `409 price_changed`; where the club's pricing does not cover the slot, `409 slot_not_priced`; nothing changes either way. Only the series' own member may renew it (`404 not_found` otherwise).

post.summary: End your weekly series
post.description: No occurrence is booked after the series ends, and each occurrence already booked goes with it through the one cancel, as your own cancel, on the terms you accepted for it (`accepted`, as GET /me/recurring-bookings/{id}/cancellation showed them). One you did not name is cancelled only with a full refund, so a late cancel at a club that keeps the money needs `none` for it. An occurrence that stays booked (the club refuses it, or the terms differ from the ones accepted: `cancel_terms_changed`) is listed in `kept` with the reason; those cancelled are listed in `cancelled`. A date whose cancel failed is never listed as staying: the answer is `upstream_error` and the ending is left unfinished, so asking again cancels it. Ending one that stopped part way (`ending: true`) finishes it; a series whose ending is finished answers with `kept` and `cancelled` empty. `404 not_found` when it is not your series.

get.summary: What ending your weekly series would do
get.description: For each occurrence it already booked that has not started: `refund` `full`, `none`, or null with the reason in `error` (it stays booked). Send these back as `accepted` to POST /me/recurring-bookings/{id}/cancel. Advisory: the cancel decides again when it runs. `404 not_found` when it is not your active series, or one you began ending that is still `ending`.

get.summary: The club's waivers and the caller's signatures
get.description: Every active waiver of the club, in the club's order. A booking or an enrollment is refused until the required ones are signed.

get.summary: One program
get.description: Under the same visibility rules as the list; a program the caller may not see is `program_not_found`. Sessions are read per day with `GET /clubs/{club}/classes`.

post.summary: Enroll in a program
post.description: A full program yields an enrollment with status `waitlisted` rather than an error, so read `status`. A priced program, or one the club confirms by hand, yields `pending`; `payable` says whether to pay now. The club's required waivers must be signed first, by the caller (`waiver_required`, with the club in `details.club_id`). The player's own membership, level and age decide: a player who is not an active member of the program's club is `not_club_member`, and one the program's level does not admit is `program_not_available`. Enrolling anyone but the caller needs a guardian link to them at the program's club resting on a live consent; without one it is `403 not_authorized`. The caller is recorded as who made the enrollment.

get.description: Unfulfilled entries, by date and start time.

post.summary: Wait for a court slot
post.description: When a matching slot frees, everyone waiting is notified; the slot is not assigned. Book on the notification. Name a `court_id` (an active court of the club), or a `court_type` (one the club has) for any court of that type. The caller must be an active member of the club, or not a member at all of a club that takes public bookings.

discount_amount_cents.description: What a discount code took off, in cents.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the club's currency, e.g. `EUR`.

price_source.description: One of `list` (the club's price list) or `staff` (club staff set the price; it no longer follows the list).

hold_expires_at.description: A pending booking's hold: the slot is released at this instant unless confirmed. Null once confirmed.

recurring_booking_id.description: Set when this is one date of a standing weekly reservation; such a date can be cancelled but not moved.

qr_code.description: The check-in code to show at the club. Only the booker gets it: GET /bookings/{id} leaves it out for anyone else.

notes.description: The booker's notes. GET /bookings/{id} leaves them out for anyone else.

no_show_recorded_at.description: Set when the club marked the booking a no-show.

is_rainout.description: Cancelled by the club for weather.

is_open_play.description: An open-play session other members can join.

discount_code_id.description: The discount code the booker applied; null without one.

slug.description: Becomes the subdomain: 2-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, no hyphen at either end, not reserved, not shaped like a UUID. Refused with `invalid_slug`.

courts.description: 1-50 courts. An empty list is `courts_required`, an unknown court_type `invalid_court_type`.

operating_hours.description: 1-7 days; a day left out is closed. Bad hours are `invalid_hours`.

day_of_week.description: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday, each at most once.

default_price_cents.description: Price per hour on every court during opening hours, minor unit of `currency`; 0 creates no pricing rules.

owner_user_id.description: Make this account the owner instead of the caller. Needs a provisioning grant that allows it.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the link expires, 1-365. Omitted: it never expires.

max_uses.description: Joins the link allows. Omitted: unlimited.

rotate.description: Owner only: revoke every live link of the group first.

token.description: The secret to share (in a join URL). Shown once; store it if you need it again.

version.description: API_VERSION, also on every response as X-Api-Version.

advance_booking_days.description: How many days ahead a member on this plan may book.

benefits.description: What the plan includes, as the club stored it. No Clutch screen writes it yet, so its items have no fixed shape and it is usually empty: show the items you understand and ignore the rest.

prerequisite_program_id.description: A program the player must have completed first. Null: none.

schedule_pattern.description: The weekly pattern, club-local. Empty when none is set.

registration_confirmation_mode.description: `instant`, or `staff`: an enrollment stays `pending` until the club confirms it.

is_private.description: Private programs are visible only to players enrolled in them.

is_enrolled.description: The caller has a pending, confirmed or waitlisted enrollment.

next_occurrence_date.description: The next date the weekly job books and charges, by its own rule (the club's calendar, within the series' start and end; today's while a run missed it and it has not started; never a date already booked or given up). Null once it has ended.

next_charge_cents.description: What that occurrence is charged before tax, in cents: the series' price, or the club's when lower. Null once it has ended.

ending.description: You began ending it and some of its booked dates are not decided yet (a request stopped part way): it books nothing more, and POST /me/recurring-bookings/{id}/cancel again finishes it.

device_secret.description: Generated once per install (32 random bytes, base64url) and kept in secure storage; never returned.
